experiment: Shared entry, robust chronological calibration and capital-aware portfolio training
eligibility: Select each directional SMA pair from the original catalog of eight on March–June 2025 only. For every eligible crossover compute the fixed one-hour after-cost trade payoff. Choose the pair with the highest median UTC-day mean payoff, ties by original catalog order. Then run 60-minute setups for the chosen pairs, at five-minute closes +5 seconds, requiring 24 hours of complete bars and $10,000 prior-minute quote volume.
execution: Simulated base fill next minute open, stress one additional minute late. 1 or 3 bps adverse slippage per leg and 4.5 bps fees per leg. Frozen per-side exits are rescored from each mode's actual raw arrival open and elapsed time. First classifier order commits irrespective of future fill availability, with up to three minutes to fill. Mark open P&L each minute and include settled funding.
availability: From the first local candle observation, use only OHLCV versions received and recorded by that five-minute decision. Freeze each past bar's observed vintage for context. No final-candle fallback within this segment. Earlier exchange archive assumed available at completed bar close plus five seconds. Fill/valuation series uses historical traded opens. GDELT availability and expiry inherited.
outcomes: Exit training decisions in March–September 2025 purged before Oct 1. For all entry/portfolio training and testing use the same frozen early exits. Joint ridge predicts after-cost bps, per-trade adverse excursion in bps on traded minute opens including entry slippage, and hours occupied. Direction indicator and direction interactions with price returns, trend and relative returns; contemporary GDELT predictors. Equal UTC-date weighting and equal setup weights within each date. Normalized ridge penalty 0.005.
calibration: Expanding entry fits start 2025-10-01. Produce predictions for February to August 2026 with all eligible past observations and a full outcome purge. Side-specific each-month shrinkage slope with 25 bps-squared variance penalty and equal-day/setup weights. Use median slope and median intercept over prior matured monthly blocks (at least three). Zero median slope disables entries on that side. Strict hurdle 15 bps. No fitting or policy selection on test P&L.
portfolio: Start each development episode and each continuous holdout book at $1,000. At most ten open positions, one per symbol, once per directional setup. Reserve cash at decision. New risk cannot take marked gross plus order notional and entry fee above current marked equity. Candidate utility in bps = calibrated expected bps minus risk_weight × predicted adverse excursion × (1 + same-side gross/equity) minus bps_per_hour × predicted hours × (1 + occupied_slots/10). Recompute between orders. Require utility >15. Explore notional {50,100}, risk weight {0,0.10,0.30}, time cost {0,2}, and cash. Fixed-size obligations are held through their exit. No intratrade forced deleveraging.
selection: Replay each action on out-of-fold entry and calibration forecasts for May, June, July, and Aug 1–20/21 with a 24h maturity buffer before the next block. Use mean across blocks of the worse of base/stress (net dollars minus 0.25 times marked max drawdown) per block calendar day. Cash earns zero and wins zero ties. Stable grid order breaks other ties. Save highest-ranked noncash action as a declared diagnostic if cash wins.
test: Same previously inspected Aug 22 through Nov 21 21:20 UTC exclusive entry boundary, mark to Nov 22 21:25 UTC. Run continuous base and fully reallocated stress ledgers. Controls: cash, corrected full ridge without learned allocation, corrected market + direction, tied priority on the same corrected news gate, and previous pooled entry score with corrected inputs, exits and money constraints. Previously inspected research dates and the user-specified 15 bps hurdle overlap test; only a later unseen block can test generalization.
